verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and back-office platform, so document automation through an API or MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented NDA drafting, e-signature routing, public API, or MCP server. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent draft an NDA and route it for signature end-to-end via the product's API or MCP server
